dedupe_keys.name: tbbr raw rooftop rgb and thermal drone imagery

description: Karlsruhe Institute of Technology and collaborators publish the original drone photographs used to develop the TBBR rooftop thermal-bridge dataset. The deposit contains 5,696 images, equally divided between RGB and thermal cameras, covering six central Karlsruhe building blocks. Acquisition took place on 19 March 2019 between 07:00 and 08:00. RGB JPGs have 4,000 by 3,000 pixels and thermal JPGs 640 by 512 pixels. Six ZIP archives and a CSV identifying annotated image pairs are free under CC BY 4.0. These originals permit alternative image alignment or feature extraction before estimating building-envelope inputs for simulations such as model-energyplus. A caveat is that repeated overlapping views are not independent building samples. The thermal observations reflect one morning, emissivity setting and weather condition; they are not direct heat-transfer coefficients. Filenames encode the RGB/thermal pairing. No archive or image was downloaded.
